limitations: Budget caps count bytes; they do not bound process RSS or footprint
FaultPlan fails alloc calls only; resize/remap failures are not injected
arena reuse with retained capacity (64 KiB) is a constant only; release frees everything to the child allocator, which may or may not return pages to the OS
worker scratch has no dedicated type: a worker takes its own reservation and ReservedAllocator (T09 executor to own it)
per-task fair shares (available_inflight / active_tasks) and pressure-driven cap changes are not implemented (T09, T16)
Budget uses a spin lock sized for counter updates; contention under many threads is not measured
process footprint probe exists on macOS only; Linux RSS/PSS/cgroup is T17; Linux and Intel macOS are cross-compiled only
journal_estimate_bytes (64 KiB) is a placeholder for T12
